title: In paradisum.
html_source: (May the angels lead you) into paradise.

anchor.prefix:
d businessmen, consumptive girls with little sparrows' breasts. All the year round he prayed the same thing over them all and shook water on top of them: sleep. On Dignam now. 

—
anchor.suffix:
Said he was going to paradise or is in paradise. Says that over everybody. Tiresome kind of a job. But he has to say something. 

 The priest closed his book and went off, foll
